label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD shall be _____ over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.
verse: And the LORD shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.
note: The prophecy's grand finale — one LORD, one name, King over all the earth.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a _____, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
verse: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
note: Suffering lasts 'a while'; God's eternal glory lasts forever — and He'll make you strong in between.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make _____ of skins, and clothed them.
verse: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
note: Before sending them out, God himself made Adam and Eve coats of skins — an upgrade from fig-leaf aprons.

label: Deep Water
prompt: They that go down to the sea in _____, that do business in great waters;
verse: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
note: The sailors' stanza of Psalm 107: storm, terror, cry, calm — and a safe harbor.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world _____ down are come hither also;
verse: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
note: The Thessalonian mob's complaint became a compliment: these men 'have turned the world upside down.'
